---
name: requirement-analysis
description: Use when turning a marketplace idea into actors, scope, acceptance criteria, open questions, risk, and learning objectives.
---

Read `/AGENTS.md`, the relevant spec template, and product context. Identify the user problem, actors, success behavior, out-of-scope work, assumptions, open questions, risk level, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. Output a concise requirement record and stop for unresolved high-risk decisions.

Quality check: every acceptance criterion must be observable and every important ambiguity must be explicit.
